groupings.title: Deploy models on Intel GPUs
groupings.description: A collection of Agent Skills for setting up, running, benchmarking, and profiling arbitrary Hugging Face safetensors and GGUF models on Intel GPUs, discrete and integrated. Covers the PyTorch + Transformers, vLLM-XPU, SGLang-XPU, llama.cpp-SYCL and OpenVINO Model Server stacks, plus CUDA to XPU migration.

groupings.title: Intel Data Parallel NumPy (dpnp)
groupings.description: NumPy-compatible arrays on Intel CPU and GPU—install, migrate from NumPy/CuPy, arrays I/O, linear algebra, RNG, memory, interop, and troubleshooting.

groupings.title: Linux CPU performance & benchmarking
groupings.description: Profile and optimize on Linux with perf, apply x86/C++ performance patterns, and run or tune Phoronix Test Suite benchmarks.
